title: College Degree Remains Big Prize for Many Student-athletes
titleZh: 对许多学生运动员来说，大学学位依然是巨大的回报
credits: Cheyanna Mumphrey, Michael Marot, and David Brandt reported on this story for the Associated Press. Hai Do adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Name, image, and likeness, or NIL, deals have enabled student-athletes to make money while going to college in the United States.
sentences.zh: 姓名、形象和肖像权，即NIL，协议已使学生运动员在美国上大学期间能够赚钱。

sentences.en: But outside of some big-name athletes, many say that a degree remains the biggest, most important prize for going to school.
sentences.zh: 但在一些知名运动员之外，许多人表示，学位仍然是上学最大的、最重要的奖励。

sentences.en: For years, college athletes could only receive free education and living costs while competing for school teams.
sentences.zh: 多年来，大学生运动员在为学校队参赛时只能获得免费教育和生活费用。

sentences.en: But that changed in 2021 when the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that athletes could earn money by selling their name, image and likeness.
sentences.zh: 但这种情况在2021年发生了变化，当时美国最高法院裁定运动员可以通过出售自己的姓名、形象和肖像权来赚钱。

sentences.en: Well-known athletes like Jayden Daniels, now with the Washington Commanders, and Caitlin Clark, who currently plays for the Indiana Fever, made large amounts of money while in college.
sentences.zh: 像如今效力于华盛顿指挥官队的杰登·丹尼尔斯，以及目前效力于印第安纳狂热队的凯特琳·克拉克等知名运动员，在上大学期间赚取了大量金钱。

sentences.en: But several athletes told The Associated Press that the money available to them through NIL remains a small consideration compared with earning a degree and competing in the sports they love.
sentences.zh: 但有几位运动员告诉美联社，通过NIL协议 available给他们的钱，与获得学位和从事他们热爱的运动相比，仍然是一个次要的考虑因素。

sentences.en: NIL deals were not on Jonny Bottorff’s mind when he transferred to Northern Arizona University on a football scholarship from a small college in Missouri.
sentences.zh: 当乔尼·博托夫从密苏里州的一所小学院以足球奖学金转入北亚利桑那大学时，NIL协议并不在他的考虑范围内。

sentences.en: Bottorff said, “I think the reality for most college athletes is things haven’t really changed that much.
sentences.zh: 博托夫说：“我认为大多数大学生运动员的现实情况是，事情并没有真正发生太大变化。

sentences.en: We just got an extra little bit of cash in our pockets...”
sentences.zh: 我们只是口袋里多了一点小钱……”

sentences.en: For some athletes, NIL money is a reason to stay longer in college.
sentences.zh: 对某些运动员来说，NIL的钱是他们留在大学更长时间的一个原因。

sentences.en: But Anthony Leal said he is staying at Indiana University for a different reason.
sentences.zh: 但安东尼·利阿尔说他留在印第安纳大学是出于另一个原因。

sentences.en: Leal plays for Indiana’s basketball team.
sentences.zh: 利阿尔效力于印第安纳大学的篮球队。

sentences.en: Under college athletic rules, he can play four seasons for the team within five years.
sentences.zh: 根据大学生体育规则，他可以在五年内为球队效力四个赛季。

sentences.en: Leal already received his undergraduate degree last year.
sentences.zh: 利阿尔去年已经获得了本科学位。

sentences.en: But he is coming back as a fifth-year student to get a master’s in business administration.
sentences.zh: 但他作为第五年学生回来攻读工商管理硕士学位。

sentences.en: “I’m about 70 percent through the program in the Kelley School of Business,” he said.
sentences.zh: “我已经完成了凯利商学院项目的大约70%,”他说。

sentences.en: “I wanted to get that degree.”
sentences.zh: “我想要获得那个学位。”

sentences.en: Another change in college rules also makes it easy for athletes to transfer and play the next season.
sentences.zh: 大学规则的另一项变化也使运动员更容易转学并在下一赛季参赛。

sentences.en: Under previous rules, athletes had to sit out a year before competing.
sentences.zh: 根据以前的规则，运动员在参赛前必须坐等一年。

sentences.en: Now, the top athletes can enter what is called a transfer portal to get more NIL money at another school and compete right away.
sentences.zh: 现在，顶尖运动员可以进入所谓的转学门户，在另一所学校获得更多NIL钱并立即参赛。

sentences.en: University of Nevada, Las Vegas football player Matthew Sluka, for one, recently left the team in a dispute over an NIL payment.
sentences.zh: 内华达大学拉斯维加斯分校的橄榄球运动员马修·斯卢卡就是其中之一，他最近因一笔NIL（姓名、形象和肖像权）付款纠纷而离开了球队。

sentences.en: His representative said he was promised payment but never received it.
sentences.zh: 他的代表说他被承诺获得报酬却从未收到。

sentences.en: But Ray Harrison said NIL money was not the reason why he left Presbyterian College and joined the basketball team at Grand Canyon University in Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 但雷·哈里森说，他离开普林斯顿学院并加入位于亚利桑那州凤凰城的大峡谷大学篮球队，原因并非NIL资金。

sentences.en: Harrison said, “I just came out here because this is where God led my heart.
sentences.zh: 哈里森说：“我只是来到这里，因为这里是上帝指引我内心的地方。

sentences.en: Of course, we win two (conference) championships and that changes things.”
sentences.zh: 当然，我们赢得了两项（联盟）冠军，这改变了局面。”

sentences.en: A college education remains a dream for many younger athletes.
sentences.zh: 大学教育对许多年轻运动员来说仍然是一个梦想。

sentences.en: Tavarius Covington from Chicago wants to continue to play football in college.
sentences.zh: 来自芝加哥的塔瓦卢斯·科温顿想继续在大学打橄榄球。

sentences.en: He hopes that football will help him become the first in his family to go to college and earn a business degree.
sentences.zh: 他希望橄榄球能帮助他成为家族中第一个上大学并获得商业学位的人。

sentences.en: He also wants to be an example for his younger brother.
sentences.zh: 他也想成为弟弟的榜样。

sentences.en: “I want him to know there is more to look forward to coming out of high school,” Covington said.
sentences.zh: “我想让他知道，高中毕业后还有更多值得期待的东西，”科温顿说。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·罗素。

glossary.def: to withdraw from one educational institution to enroll at another
